description: Source code for the Material Request doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, validation, and various helper functions for managing material requests, stock entries, work orders, and related operations.

classes.name: MaterialRequest
classes.description: Main class representing a Material Request, inheriting from BuyingController, with methods for validation, status updates, and related operations.

methods.name: get_feed
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with the current status and request type.

methods.name: check_if_already_pulled
methods.description: Placeholder method for checking if items are already pulled.

methods.name: validate_qty_against_so
methods.description: Validates requested quantities against sales order quantities.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the material request, including schedule date, status, and items.

methods.name: set_title
methods.description: Sets the title of the request based on item names.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Operations to perform upon submission, including updating quantities and validating budget.

methods.name: before_cancel
methods.description: Checks if the request is on hold or closed before canceling.

methods.name: check_modified_date
methods.description: Checks if the document has been modified since last fetch.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the status of the request after validation.

methods.name: status_can_change
methods.description: Validates if the status change is permissible based on current status.

methods.name: update_completed_qty
methods.description: Updates the completed quantity for items in the request.

methods.name: update_requested_qty
methods.description: Updates the requested quantity in stock bins.

methods.name: update_requested_qty_in_production_plan
methods.description: Updates requested quantities in associated production plans.
